title: The Letter Spread Before God
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A scary letter came one day,
That made the king afraid,
It said, “Your God can’t save you now!”
He didn’t fight, he prayed.

[Chorus]
When worries come, I know what’s best,
I’ll spread them out and pray,
Heavenly Father hears me now
And takes my fear away.

[Verse 2]
He took it to the temple, where
He spread it open wide,
“Don’t be afraid,” the Lord sent word,
“I’m right here by your side.”

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So close your eyes and give to God
The worries that you keep,
He hears you in the quiet night
And watches while you sleep.

[Chorus]
mood: Unfolding music. A slow, hushed sway begins a little uneasy, like a worried king carrying a letter up the temple steps, then eases as the letter is spread open and the fear is handed over. The chorus breathes out with relief each time it returns, warm and unhurried. By the last verse the sway is barely moving, lower and slower, like a child letting go of the day and drifting off.
